Name: KittenTyme's Gloomy Recolor
Author: KittenTyme
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=4][u]I am giving permission to anyone who wants to update this to 1.6 as long as credit is given.

[/u][/size][/color]I am glad there are people who like my mod enough to be asking for a 1.6 update, but I am simply lacking in motivation to do it myself. I will probably make an offical update at some point, but it's going to be a while, so I am opening this up to anyone who wants to take a crack at it themselves.

Ever thought that you needed a desaturated, darker recolor with a touch of blue? Well, do I have a mod for you!

This is an intensive recolor of almost everything I could find. The only things this does not recolor are the farmer, clothing, npcs, monsters, and the mines. Animals, maps, tools, environment, food, collectibles, etc, are all recolored. Also includes a slightly creepy new dig spot.  Warning, some areas get super dark and people with poor eyesight might have some issues seeing things.

-INSTALLATION-

Unzip and toss into the mod folder, easy peasy.

(Note: If you have a mod that alters the graphics, like Animated Gemstones, make sure to load that mod AFTER the Recolor.)

-VERSION 1.1.0-

Rock crabs now blend in.
-------------------------------------------------------------

This has not been thoroughly tested, so if there is a problem, tell me and I'll fix it as soon as I get to it.


For mod authors who want to make something in a similar color, I used an online editor called Pixlr E, then set Saturation to -75, Temp to -25, and Shadows to -100. If you use these settings in a mod, please credit, otherwise, go wild.
